subject: french

moments.title: Storming of the Bastille
moments.body: On 14 July 1789 a Paris crowd takes the Bastille fortress. The date becomes France's national day.
moments.takeaway: Symbolic acts can outlast their tactical purpose.

moments.title: Declaration of the Rights of Man
moments.body: The Declaration enshrines liberty, equality and resistance to oppression.
moments.takeaway: Constitutional language shaped global human rights vocabulary.

moments.title: Execution of Louis XVI
moments.body: The king is guillotined on 21 January 1793, followed by Marie Antoinette in October.
moments.takeaway: The Revolution moved from reform to regicide in four years.

now.title: Revolution's legacy
now.body: Liberte, egalite, fraternite remains the Republic's motto. Bastille Day parades march down the Champs-Elysees.
now.open_questions: How are revolutionary ideals still contested in contemporary France?

reflection: Modern French political identity is dated from a summer of crowds.
